summary_short: EchoStar's Q2 FY2026 revenue was $3,576.2M, down 4.0% y/y and 2.5% q/q; net income swung to $8,462.4M and diluted EPS to $24.12, both from year-ago losses, while cash fell 81.3% y/y to $440.0M.
summary_long: Revenue was $3,576.2M, down 4.0% y/y and 2.5% q/q. Gross margin was about 34.4%, up from 24.4% y/y. Operating income was $512.9M versus a $213.4M loss a year ago. Diluted EPS was $24.12 versus a $1.06 loss y/y and a $0.51 loss q/q, on net income of $8,462.4M versus a $306.1M loss y/y. Cash fell to $440.0M, down 81.3% y/y and 67.3% q/q; shareholders' equity fell 28.3% y/y to $14,155.1M.
